decision_rule: Only entries accepted into the final v1.0 allowlist become stable. This proposal is not a compatibility promise.

commands.rules: Validate and count a rule file; success report has rules_count and rules.
commands.scan: Scan the full target byte buffer using --rules <path>.
commands.pcap: Scan each captured frame in classic PCAP separately using --rules <path>; no stream reassembly.

exit_codes.0: A report was produced and either there were no findings or --fail-on-match was not supplied.
exit_codes.10: --fail-on-match was supplied and at least one finding was produced.

stdout.machine_reports: Exactly one JSON object for rules, scan, pcap, and structured errors.

report_schema.unknown_fields: Rejected; any report-field contract change requires incrementing schema_version.

input_contract.file_scan: Scan all bytes, including bytes after NUL; scanned_bytes and target_sha256 cover the complete file.
input_contract.regex_with_nul: Reject explicitly because the current regex path cannot preserve byte spans across NUL.
input_contract.pcap: Classic PCAP only, supported timestamp resolutions and byte orders; scan raw captured frame bytes independently. pcapng is rejected.

hex_patterns: one negated byte within documented combination limits
yara_subset.regex: POSIX ERE subject to documented safety checks.

limitations: This does not stabilize the general Axiom language grammar or every compiler/stdlib symbol used internally by the example.
External YARA differential coverage is a pinned sample, not proof of complete YARA compatibility.
The offline DFIR product focus and this candidate require maintainer confirmation before becoming the final stable allowlist.
